title: Lines and Angles
subtitle: Understanding the Foundations of Geometry
subject: Mathematics
author: Shine Academy AI Team
learning_outcomes: Understand theorems related to intersecting lines
Apply properties of parallel lines and transversals to solve problems
Use angle sum property of a triangle

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the properties of angles formed by intersecting lines and transversals across parallel lines.
common_misconceptions: Confusing alternate interior angles with consecutive interior angles
Assuming any transversal creates equal corresponding angles (only true for parallel lines)
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles with parallel lines properties, ask them to visualize a Z or F shape to find alternate or corresponding angles.
